content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the klaipeda district court the court proceedings lasted for three days and the costs of the case were paid by the defendant the court decided that a car would be recognized as the personal property of the applicant and ordered the applicant to pay the defendant compensation the court also divided the apartment parking lot and land plot between the parties the court considered various articles from the civil code related to matrimonial property the applicant applied for the dissolution of the marriage division of property child maintenance and compensation for damages the court awarded the applicant a share of the apartment and ordered the defendant to pay compensation the defendant filed a counterclaim for child maintenance and was awarded a share of the property the court also recognized a debt owed by the defendant to a third party the court explained the process of dividing community property in a divorce case and determined that certain properties were acquired during the marriage there were disputes over the sale of a car and the acquisition of the apartment which the court resolved in favor of the applicant the court deviated from the principle of equal division of property to grant the applicant a greater share the court also upheld the applicants claim for the defendants personal debt the court ordered the party who was successful in the judgment to pay the costs of the proceedings in this case the applicant paid a stamp duty and legal fees while the defendant paid a stamp duty and legal fees the court can deviate from the general rules of cost allocation based on the parties conduct the court considered the principles of justice fairness and reasonableness in allocating costs the court ordered the applicant to pay the defendant compensation and divided the assets between the parties the court also recognized a personal obligation of the defendant to a company the remaining parts of the application and counterclaim were dismissed

civil_codes_used: Art. 3.117 Shares in the matrimonial property
Art. 3.123 Deviation from equal shares of the spouses' community property
Art. 3.87 The essence of the statutory matrimonial property regime
Art. 3.89 Personal property of the spouses
